stem: One plant in a room is severely wilted while surrounding plants appear normal. What is the most useful Technician I response?
choices: Assume the entire room has a nutrient deficiency
Document the affected plant and location, compare nearby plants and available measurements, and escalate the abnormality
Increase irrigation to every plant in the room immediately
Remove all leaves from the wilted plant before recording it
rationale: A technician should document the pattern and context before making unsupported causal assumptions. Comparison and escalation preserve useful diagnostic evidence.
